chapter.verse: Ikonium khua Judah mi kikhopna inn sungah a lut uh a, thu a hilh uh ciangin, Judah mi leh Grik mi tampite in a um uh hi.
Thu-um lo Judah mite in unaute a huat bawlna dingun Gentailte a hansuah uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin a sawtpi tua san takah a om uh a, lau loin Topa’ min tawh thu a hilh uh hi. Topa in amaute’ khut tungah lim leh nalamdang bawl dingin thu pia-in, ama hehpihna thu ading teci a pang hi.
Khua sung mi honpite a kikhen uh a, kimkhat in Judah mite lamah, kimkhat in sawltakte lamah a kipawl uh hi.
Gentailte leh Judahte in upate tawh bawlsia uh a, suang tawh a deng dingin nakpi-in a delh ding uh,
amaute in a theihkholh uh ciangin Likaonia khua, Listra khua leh Derbe khua akipan,
tua khua kim gamah a tai uh a, tua gamah Lungdamna Thu a hilh uh hi.
Listra khua-ah a nu gil sung pan a khe zaw a, khatvei beek lam pai ngei lo thahat lo mi khat in tu-in a om hi.
Amah in Paul’ thu a ngaih lai takin Paul in amah a tel-et ciangin a dam theih nading upna a neih a muh ciangin,
“Na khe tawh na dingtang ta in,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko ciangin, tua pa ding-in lam a pai hi.
Paul hihna mihonpite in a muh uh ciangin, “Pasiante in mi meel bangin eite kiangah hong kumsuk hi,” ci-in Likaonia pau-in a kiko uh hi.
Barnabas pen Zeas ci uh a, Paul in thugen penpa ahih ciangin Hermes a ci uh hi.
Khua mai-ah a om Zeas biakna innpi siampipa in pak leh bawngpi la-in kongpi kiangah paipih a, mihonpi tawh bia dingin a kisa uh hi.
Sawltakpi Paul leh Barnabas-te in a zak uh ciangin a puan balkek uh a, mihonpi lakah tai-in

“Mite aw, bang hangin hih bangin bawl na hi uh hiam? Komau in note tawh kibang lungsim nei mite ka hi uh a, hih a mawkna paaikhia-in van leh lei, tui lianpi akipan leh a sungah a om teng a piangsak a nungta Pasian kiangah na kihei nadingun Lungdamna Thu kong hilh uh hi.
Tua Pasian in khang masa hun lai-in mipawl khempeuhte in, amau ut bangin a gamtat nading uh thu a pia hi.

Ahih hangin tecipan’na om loin amahmah a kinusia kei hi; amah in ama gitna hong lakin, vantung pan guahtui leh amau hun ciat a, a gah an hong pia hi; amah in an tampi hong pia-in na lungtang uh lungnopna tawh hong dimsak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu tawh mi honpite in a biak loh nadingun haksapi-in a kham uh hi.
Ahih hangin Antiok khua leh Ikonium khua panin Judah mite hong pai uh a, mihonte a hansuah khit uh ciangin Paul suang tawh a deng uh a, a si khin ta hi ci-in khua nawlah a kaikhia uh hi.
Ahih hangin nungzuite in ama kimkot ah a om lai takun tho a, khua sungah a tum kik hi. Zingsang ciangin Barnabas tawh taikhia a, Derbe khua-ah a tung uh hi.
Amaute in tua khua sungah Lungdamna Thu a hilh uh a, tampitak nungzuite a suaksak khit uh ciangin Listra khua, Ikonium khua leh Antiok khua-ah ciahkik-in, nungzuite a lungkipsak uh a,
“Eite in gimna tampi thuakin Pasian’ Gam sungah i tum ding ahi hi,” ci-in upna sungah a kip nadingun, hansuahin thu a hilh uh hi.
Pawlpite khempeuh ah amaute’ adingin upate a koih sak uh a, an tangin thu a nget khit uh ciangin, amaute in a up uh Pasian’ khut sungah a ap uh hi.
Pisidia gamah a paisuak uh a, Pamfilia gamah a tung uh hi.
Perga khua-ah Pasian’ thu a hilh khit uh ciangin Attalia khua-ah a paisuk uh hi.
Tua khua panin tu-in a zawh khitsa a nasep adingin Pasian’ hehpihna thupha sungah ki-ap uh a, teembaw tuangin Antiok khua a tungkik uh hi.
A tun’ uh ciangin pawlpite kikhawmsak uh a, amaute tungah Pasian’ bawlna leh Gentailte ading thu upna kong kihon’na thu teng a zasak uh hi.
Nungzuite tawh sawtpi a omkhawm uh hi.
